dependency_edges.handoff: Cleaned categories, prices and sectors feed revised EROI.
Screened historical factors feed the linear baseline.
Two baseline failures define the dynamic replacement's job.
The fitted dynamic system produces ten-category state forecasts.
No-policy level/share behavior triggers an incremental shock layer.
Policy simulations and state-only limits motivate compact duties.
Selected dynamic parameters feed the bounded sensitivity illustration.
EROI ranks and targets are cited in the action handoff.
Appendix functions consume the paper's cleaned-data and EROI interfaces.
Python code mirrors portions of EROI accounting; MATLAB mirrors entropy weighting.
